description: Integration registry. 'shipped' integrations are declared in the plugin .mcp.json; others are opt-in and documented in docs/MCP.md.

ui-ux-pro-max.install: claude plugin marketplace add nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill && claude plugin install ui-ux-pro-max@ui-ux-pro-max-skill
ui-ux-pro-max.fallback: Designer works from skills/frontend-engineering design rules; DESIGN_SYSTEM.md must state that UI UX Pro Max was unavailable.

playwright.fallback: Executed Playwright test suite via run_checks (e2e kind). Exploratory browser QA is then reported NOT_RUN.

context7.auth: optional API key (not configured by DevPipeline)
context7.fallback: Agents use WebFetch on official docs URLs listed in the skills.

chrome-devtools.enable: claude mcp add chrome-devtools --scope user -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@1.14.0 --isolated --headless --no-usage-statistics

github.note: Not required for local development. Never enabled by DevPipeline.

database.note: Never expose production databases. Use isolated test databases.
